comment: Failure-mode catalog consumed by scripts/mc/provider-smoke.js (T-20260513-019) and scripts/mc/lib/provider-rca.js (T-20260513-022). Each entry maps a provider-health status to a root_cause + safe_to_autofix + fix_recipe + remediation + fallback_allowed signal. β-decided defaults applied 2026-05-13: only `trusted_directory_required` is safe_to_autofix=true; `auth_source_mismatch` is fallback_allowed=false (mirrors provider-fallback.json#do_not_fall_back).

severity_buckets.comment: Severity matches scripts/mc/provider-smoke.js#iconFor. 'ok' is green; the three statuses above are yellow (non-blocking unless --exit-on-yellow); everything else is red.

cli_missing.root_cause: Provider CLI binary not found on PATH or not installed.
cli_missing.remediation: Install the provider CLI. claude: `npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`. openai: `npm i -g @openai/codex`. antigravity: install the standalone Antigravity `agy` CLI (not npm). Then re-run.

auth_missing.root_cause: Provider CLI is installed but session/login is missing or expired.
auth_missing.remediation: Authenticate the CLI interactively. claude: `claude /login`. openai: `codex login`. antigravity: sign in to Antigravity (`agy`) so its ~/.gemini keyring carries a session. This is a DAY-ZERO step on every fresh install / new machine, and a MC/CLI update can reset it — without it the gauntlet silently falls back off the Gemini lab and loses adversarial-corpus diversity. Never auto-fix — interactive auth requires the operator.

auth_source_mismatch.root_cause: Both an API key env var AND a CLI OAuth session are set — the provider has an ambiguous credential source, so a stale/quota-limited key can win over a working plan session and fail the gauntlet even though the CLI works interactively.
auth_source_mismatch.remediation: Choose ONE credential source. openai: unset OPENAI_API_KEY or `codex logout` to prefer the plan session, or keep the metered key deliberately. Mirrors provider-fallback.json#do_not_fall_back to surface the ambiguity rather than silently picking.

model_not_found.root_cause: Requested model id is not in the CLI's bundled registry — usually stale CLI version.
model_not_found.remediation: Upgrade the provider CLI: `npm i -g @<vendor>/<cli>@latest`. Then re-run.

stale_cli_registry.root_cause: Provider CLI registry is older than the configured target models.
stale_cli_registry.remediation: Upgrade the provider CLI to refresh its bundled model registry: `npm i -g @<vendor>/<cli>@latest`.

trusted_directory_required.root_cause: LEGACY (SUNSET gemini CLI) — retained as a catalog placeholder. No live provider emits this status after the 2026-07-20 deep-clean; the supported agy lane has no workspace-trust gate.
trusted_directory_required.remediation: No action — this failure mode belonged to the removed individual gemini CLI.

provider_timeout.root_cause: Probe wall-clock budget exceeded before provider responded.

fix_recipe.note: Network/CLI transient. One retry with the same timeout is cheap and catches most flap-class failures. T-023 owns this dispatcher.

provider_timeout.remediation: Auto-retry attempted. If still red after retry, check network and provider status.

quota_exhausted.root_cause: Provider rate limit or hard quota hit.
quota_exhausted.remediation: Wait for the quota window to reset, upgrade tier, or rely on the configured provider-fallback policy. Auto-fixing quota is not possible without billing changes.

free_tier_limit_zero.root_cause: Provider account has a free-tier daily limit of zero (account misconfiguration or expired trial).
free_tier_limit_zero.remediation: Switch the account to a paid tier, or configure the provider-fallback policy to route around this provider for non-critical roles.

unknown_error.root_cause: Unclassified provider error — likely a new failure mode not yet catalogued.
unknown_error.remediation: Inspect the smoke event in events.jsonl for full stderr (truncated 400 chars in CLI output). Consider adding a new catalog entry if this recurs.
